title: Ali and Ayse
text:
My friend Ali is very kind. He always helps me with my homework. He is also funny, and we laugh a lot together. Ali is a little shy with new people, but he is never rude.

My sister Ayse is different. She is very quiet at home, but at school she is loud and brave. She likes to speak in front of the class. Ayse is also very honest. She always tells the truth.

questions.text: What does Ali always help me with?
What kind of person is Ali?

vocabulary.definition: friendly and helpful to other people
nervous or quiet with other people
not afraid of danger or difficult things

paragraph_translations: Arkadaşım Ali çok naziktir. Bana her zaman ödevimde yardım eder. Ayrıca komiktir ve birlikte çok gülüyoruz. Ali yeni insanlarla biraz utangaçtır ama asla kaba değildir.
Kız kardeşim Ayşe farklıdır. Evde çok sessizdir, ama okulda yüksek sesli ve cesurdur. Sınıfın önünde konuşmayı sever. Ayşe ayrıca çok dürüsttür. Her zaman doğruyu söyler.
